_doc: The Altstadt's secrets (T-0067, docs/design/discoveries.md). from/to: "HH:MM" window it can be uncovered in (to before from wraps past midnight; equal = all day). level: the place's floor. clue_required: false lets a search at the place find the clue. share_trust: trust needed to share the clue in a conversation, -1 = never shared. effects: note {text}, money {cents} (once per world), moodlet {moodlet}, contact {place_id}: you get to know its residents or staff, unlock_interaction {interaction}: one whose requires_discovery is this. scene: optional, shown to the player on finding it. discoveries.name: Coins in the fountain
discoveries.clue: People toss coins into the Altmarkt fountain. Late at night nobody's watching.

effects.text: You fished €3.40 out of the fountain. Nobody saw.
